metric_definitions.aggregation: Macro average across non-empty queries. Expected-empty queries are measured separately with specificity.
metric_definitions.mrr: Reciprocal rank of the first returned atom that supports any expected evidence ID.
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_6: Binary relevance nDCG over returned atoms; expected duplicate observations that share one atom count as one retrievable item.
metric_definitions.precision_at_6: Relevant returned atom positions divided by six, even when fewer than six atoms are returned.
metric_definitions.recall_at_6: Unique expected canonical atoms represented by the top six returned atoms divided by unique expected canonical atoms. Expected labels without an ingestible atom are counted as unmatched units.
